# GeoAICubes — agent quick index

## Commands
- uv sync
- make check          # ruff src+tests, format, docs smoke, pytest
- make test           # pytest integration + unit
- make api / make ui  # native dev
- make up-d           # Docker Compose stack

## Layout
- src/geoaicubes/     Python core (shared by API, CLI, notebooks, benchmarks)
- apps/viewer/        Svelte UI — API only
- config/.env.example Storage + API env SSOT template
- docs/demo-config.md Storage, logging, MinIO runbook
- docs/scaffold.md    Ports and health URLs
- references/         Plec contracts (markdown + PDF)

## Deliverables map
- references/deliverables-technical-scope.md
- references/implementation-roadmap.md

## Tests
- tests/integration/, tests/unit/ — pytest (CI)
- tests/e2e/ — Cursor /test workflow

## Boundaries
- .cursor/rules/geoaicubes-context.mdc — architecture
- .cursor/rules/viewer-api-boundary.mdc — no geospatial core in viewer
